name: Qube Browser 0.5.0
notes:
Qube 0.5.0: notes, a smarter command bar, and a Space for streaming.

This one is packed. Write and sketch without leaving your browser, get anywhere from the command bar, and keep all your streaming services in a Space of their own. Qube now also runs on Windows 365 Cloud PCs and virtual machines.

Notes, right in your sidebar:
* A note is a tab: an Easy Note for writing, or an Advanced Note with a whiteboard to draw and arrange on
* Headings, lists, links and pictures in your text
* Every note in the Library, each with a picture of what is on it
* Start a new note from the + menu or the command bar

A command bar that keeps up with you:
* Calm and keyboard-first, with the thing you most likely want right on top
* Everything the menus can do, a few letters away
* Ask AI straight from the bar: it turns into a chat on the spot

Qube Spark:
* Chat with Claude or ChatGPT, in tabs of their own and kept in the Library
* Ask about the page you are reading, right from Find on Page

A Space for streaming:
* One Space with a big tile for each of your streaming services
* Sign in once in Settings, and only your services show up
* A soft glow round whatever is playing
* Drag the tiles into your own order

Little Qube:
* Links from other apps can open in a small window of their own
* Open any link for a quick look, without leaving your page

Music your way:
* Spotify as your music source, next to Apple Music
* Music takes on your Space's colours, and lyrics glide along with the song

Profiles that are truly yours:
* Each profile gets its own search engine, suggestions, archive time and download folder
* Extensions per profile
* Downloads land in the right profile's folder, with names you can read
* A download stack in the sidebar that follows every download, in every window

For everyone:
* All of Qube works with the keyboard and with Narrator: the sidebar, Essentials, folders, splits, the command bar, the Library, Settings, Notes and Music
* Move between the page, the sidebar and every other part without touching the mouse

Runs on more PCs:
* Works on PCs without a graphics card, such as Windows 365 Cloud PCs and virtual machines
* Your pages come back by themselves after a graphics driver update

A fresh Settings:
* Settings in the look of Windows 11, with search and neatly grouped cards

Lighter on your PC:
* Tabs you have not looked at for an hour take a rest, to free up memory
* Music only loads once you use it

Small touches:
* Give a pinned tab a short name of its own
* Drag a tab and the others slide aside to make room
* Grab the sidebar anywhere to move the window
* Your windows from last time come back when you start Qube
* An even smoother unboxing on first start

Fixed:
* Site permission questions and page dialogs no longer get lost when several arrive at once
* A tab moved to another Space right after opening keeps its page
* An empty window stays empty after a restart
summary: Notes, a smarter command bar, a Space for streaming, and Qube on Windows 365 Cloud PCs.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.7.0
mac.notes:
Added:

* The command bar puts the best match first: an open tab, a command or a site, with your search right below it
* The command bar's list holds still while you type, and the rows under the first change once, when suggestions arrive
* Site search: type a site's name or let it complete (spoti → spotify.com) and press Tab; Spotify joins the sites
* A colour flash as site search starts, and a small tap as you go in or out with Tab or Escape
* Escape leaves Ask and site search for the ordinary command bar
* The command bar and the small one in the sidebar in new sizes, with keyboard shortcuts beside commands
* Find on Page can answer questions about the page: turn it on in Settings › Qube Spark, and ⌘F asks instead of searching
* PDFs: download, print or open in Preview from a bar on the PDF, Download PDF in the page menu and the command bar, and ⇧⌘S saves the file itself
* Each profile has its own search engine, suggestions, archive time and download folder
* Edit › Spelling and Grammar and Substitutions, to turn spell checking off
* Settings in a new window, with tabs in the toolbar

Fixed:

* Pointing at the Library button hid half of the tabs in the sidebar
* Cards and Settings had a brown tint
* The find bar's ends were oddly shaped
mac.summary: A calmer, faster command bar, Find on Page that asks, and PDFs you can keep.
